title: Kenyan Stew Delight
description: A hearty and flavorful vegetarian stew originating from Kenya, made with a variety of spices and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until they are translucent.
Add the chopped bell peppers and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, carrots, and potatoes. Stir well.
Add the stew and stir well to combine.
Reduce heat to low and let it simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
